fact: Leaving the track without a justifiable reason multiple times.
offence: Breaches of Appendix L, Chapter IV, Article 2 c) of the International Sporting Code and B1.8.6 of the FIA F1 Regulations.
reason: The Stewards reviewed positioning/marshalling system data and video evidence and determined that Car 12 left the track without a justifiable reason on 4 separate occasions during the Sprint, each of which was an infringement of Appendix L, Chapter IV, Article 2 c) of the International Sporting Code and B1.8.6 of the FIA F1 Regulations. As per the Penalty Guidelines, a black and white flag was shown to the driver after the third infringement and a 5 second time penalty was imposed for the fourth infringement.
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
are based solely on the relevant regulations
title: Infringement Car 12 Leaving The Track Without A Justifiable Reason Multiple Times
